repair.root_cause: The runner inherited PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 and PYTEST_PLUGINS=xdist.plugin from the host environment. Autoload suppression prevented the declared pytest-mock entry point from loading, so tests requiring the mocker fixture errored. Normal autoload also made the runner dependent on unrelated installed plugins and could stall during Git metadata resolution.
repair.change: tools/run_tests.py now owns the child pytest environment, disables ambient plugin autoload configuration, removes PYTEST_PLUGINS, explicitly loads pytest_mock for both lanes and xdist.plugin for the parallel lane, and uses repository-wide marker selection for both lanes. The configured audio path remains classification metadata only; pytest collection is no longer narrowed or hidden by path. Skips, JUnit reporting, nonzero failure propagation, and parallel_ci serial rollback behavior are unchanged.

environment.PYTEST_PLUGINS: xdist.plugin (ambient input; runner removes it before spawning pytest)
